text:
emma (PM): Quick sync — need to lock scope for next micro-release. Customer A has an embedding streaming regression in production (intermittent stalls) + a list of 6 small UX enhancements. I’m proposing we prioritise: 1) streaming regression fix, 2) failing analytics export bug, and 3) single high-impact UX tweak (compact result view). Keep the rest for next wave. Thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devon (eng): +1 on triaging the streaming regression first. If it's KV cache related, it can blow up tail latency. Do we have a repro? liam, did support capture logs?

liam (support): I opened a ticket with customer logs and a short repro script yesterday. Behavior looks like stalled k/v fetches when token count > 1024. Will paste snippet:```python
# repro gist
resp = client.generate(model='open-internal', prompt=long_prompt, stream=True)
for chunk in resp:
    process(chunk)
```
Observed: stream yields then pauses ~4-8s occasionally.

sophia (swe): If it's sequence-length boundary, likely kernel / batching edge-case. I can take the initial debug run tomorrow. If we confirm it's RPC stall vs runtime OOM, estimate 1.5-2d to root-cause + canary.

aaron (eng-infra): Heads up: if we do a canary build, we should route a small % of traffic to a dedicated pool to avoid noisy neighbor effects. I can set up a 5% canary on dedicated infra — need a config change but low risk. :thumbsup:

emma (PM): Good. Proposal update: front-load the streaming fix + analytics export bug (customer flagged missing rows) in the micro-release; treat the compact result view as the single enhancement. If streaming fix ends up longer than 3d, fallback plan is to ship the analytics fix + UX only and postpone streaming patch to next micro. Agree?

devon (eng): Sounds reasonable. For decision criteria, suggest we use: 
- If RCA completed and unit/regression tests + canary within 72h -> include streaming fix.
- If not -> include analytics fix + UX.
Add: severity >= P1 for streaming if >5% of requests affected.

liam (support): From ticket volume, it's 2 customers so far but high impact for both. I'll mark escalation and keep monitoring.

emma (PM): Action items:
- sophia: start debug and post initial findings in this thread by EOD tomorrow.
- aaron: prep 5% canary config (dev/stage) by EOD today.
- devon: scope analytics export bug (estimate small) and be ready to pick up if streaming slips.
- liam: keep escalation notes and update SLA owners.

sophia (swe): Will post repro timeline and first heap/proc samples tomorrow. If I hit kernel-level weirdness, I may need devon to help with perf traces.

devon (eng): I can carve out time Tue-Wed for perf traces. Also quick ask: do we want to include any user-visible mitigation (toggle off streaming fallback to polling) if canary fails? That would be safe but degrades UX.

emma (PM): Prefer to avoid user-visible degrade unless we must. Make mitigation plan anyway and document risk.

aaron (eng-infra): Canary ready. I’ll wire the route and set alerts for error rate and latency jump. If we see >3x error rate, automatic rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: micro-release/afterburn-1761 -> pool-dedicated-5pct at 2026-02-12T09:30:00Z.

emma (PM): OK — final check: micro-release will contain analytics export fix + compact-result enhancement as default. Streaming fix is conditional per the decision criteria. I’ll update the release notes draft and open the PR for the UX tweak. Thanks all. :rocket:
